test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If p sin² β + q cos² β = r, then the value of cot² β is:
solution:
**Given:**

p sin² β + q cos² β = r

**Formula used:**

cot² β = (cos² β) / (sin² β)

**Calculation:**

p sin² β + q cos² β = r

⇒ p sin² β + q (1 - sin² β) = r

⇒ p sin² β + q - q sin² β = r

⇒ (p - q) sin² β + q = r

⇒ (p - q) sin² β = r - q

⇒ sin² β = (r - q) / (p - q)

⇒ cos² β = 1 - sin² β

⇒ cos² β = 1 - (r - q) / (p - q)

⇒ cos² β = (p - r) / (p - q)

⇒ cot² β = (cos² β) / (sin² β)

⇒ cot² β = [(p - r) / (p - q)] / [(r - q) / (p - q)]

⇒ cot² β = (p - r) / (r - q)

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
